en.text:
Firing grants 'Tap The Trigger' for #e${0.6+#d} seconds, providing the following benefits:
• 40 Stability
• 50% decreased Recoil
• 10% decreased Accuracy Cone Size

Fusion Rifles only receive <title 25% of the benefits [fusions] />.

Buff cannot be refreshed until Automatic Weapons stop firing, or until the next burst.

<green [Controller-Only] /> Weapon fires the instant trigger pressure is applied.
